patch_description: The current program regressed from 2.42 to 2.36 because the greedy void-filling + re-refinement loop was dropped. Re-add it: after picking the best lattice candidate, grid-sample the square to find the largest interior void; if it admits a circle with radius > 0.04, append it as a 27th center, re-refine with the existing `refine_layout` (which lets SLSQP-like reshuffling of neighbors happen via the push/pull nudge heuristic), drop the smallest circle to return to n=26, re-grow, and keep the result if the sum improves. Add a helper `find_largest_void` using vectorized grid sampling. This exploits interior gaps that the boundary-pulling heuristic leaves unexploited, which previously yielded +0.01–0.06 on top of the lattice layout.
